_comment: Filing-mapping ratchet baseline (scripts/filing_mapping_report.py --check). placed_cells may not DECREASE; unplaced_figures, and every (template, reason) cell of unplaced_by_reason, may not INCREASE. Re-measure with --update-baseline after a deliberate change and say why in _note; never type the numbers.
_note: First bank, 2026-11-13, with the introduction of the ratchet (rwa-filer Phase 2). Measured over the 13 Basel 3.1 portfolios of RUNS against the packaged PRA001 taxonomy pack v4.1.1 (104 tables, 61,615 reportable cells). 1,911 distinct generated cells land on a taxonomy data point; 1,025 distinct cells carry a NON-ZERO figure the taxonomy has no place for. This is a measurement of where the estate stands, not a target: the gap is real and pre-dates the ratchet. Its largest part (816 cells across OF 08.01/02/03/04/05) is one cause - our IRB sheets are per exposure class, while the published z-axis also splits by approach (AIRB / FIRB / slotting) and SME / non-SME, so a figure on one of our sheets cannot be assigned to a single published sheet. The remainder are row, column or cell differences between the PS1/26 templates the generators were built from and the v4.1.1 DPM (OF 02.00 rows 0220/0260/0300/0370 and its Output Floor column; OF 07.00 CRM columns on rows the taxonomy greys; OF 09.02 column 0125; OF 08.06 specialised-lending types; C 34.02 netting-set sheets), and OF 08.02's open rows, which are keyed by obligor grade and not yet mapped. Closing any of these is generator work in rwa-calc; bank the lower number when it lands.
